# Git Guide

> Every Git and GitHub answer in one place. Ask in plain language, paste an error, follow a rescue, or learn the model. Each answer gives exact commands, a danger level, and its own undo.

Author: Amey Thakur (https://github.com/Amey-Thakur)
Repository: https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/GIT-GUIDE
Site: https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/
License: MIT

## Data

- [intents.json](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/data/intents.json): plain-language questions mapped to exact commands, with variants, danger levels, and undo for each.
- [errors.json](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/data/errors.json): Git's literal error messages with cause and copy-ready fixes.
- [scenarios.json](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/data/scenarios.json): the rescue triage decision tree; leaves resolve to intent ids.
- [cheatsheet.json](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/data/cheatsheet.json): the complete command sheet grouped by task, danger-flagged.

## Pages

- [Finder](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/): search any Git question or paste an error, copy the answer.
- [Learn](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/learn.html): the visual model: where code lives, what each command moves, branches and HEAD.
- [Practise](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/play.html): an in-browser Git engine; real commands against a live commit graph, with twenty-three lessons from a first commit to opening a pull request, a conflict with real markers to resolve, and a timed recovery drill.
- [Fix](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/fix.html): guided rescue triage from panic to recipe.
- [Answers](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/answers.html): every answer rendered as static HTML, no JavaScript required: question, variants, exact commands, danger level and undo for each.
- [Errors](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/errors.html): every common Git error, decoded, statically rendered.
- [GitHub](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/github.html): the GitHub chapter: pull requests, forks, Issues, Actions, releases, Pages, gh CLI, power moves.
- [Cheatsheet](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/cheatsheet.html): the complete cheatsheet, one line per command, every platform and no platform.
- [Start](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/setup.html): zero to first push in six ordered steps.
- [Workflows](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/workflows.html): solo, feature branch, fork, trunk-based, and release workflows with the team-safety rules.

## Downloads

- [git-guide.pdf](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/assets/git-guide.pdf): the complete guide, printable: model, every command section, every error, the chapters.
- [cheatsheet-card.png](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/assets/cheatsheet-card.png): the daily commands on one printable card.
- [cheatsheet-card-2.png](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/assets/cheatsheet-card-2.png): everything beyond the daily, the second card.
- [poster.png](https://amey-thakur.github.io/GIT-GUIDE/assets/poster.png): the nine doors and the danger levels, one sheet.

## Community

- [Discussions](https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/GIT-GUIDE/discussions): every answer mirrored as an answered Q&A thread; ask anything missing.

## Conventions

- danger levels: "safe" (changes nothing you cannot get back), "history" (rewrites commit history), "destructive" (can lose work permanently).
- every command entry includes an undo, or states that none exists.
- commands are current Git (2.23+): switch and restore first, legacy forms noted.
